_comment: Purpose and resource declaration for the Memex MCP server. The gate enforces the profiles declared here; changing a tool's side_effect or an inputSchema is a security-relevant diff.
name: memex-mcp
purpose: Read and maintain a personal markdown knowledge base: search, read, write, ingest, lint, and score confidence across wiki pages.
protocol_note: Bound to what the mcp SDK 1.30.0 advertises (LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION = 2025-11-25). Moving to 2026-07-28 requires an SDK upgrade to a 2.x line.
transport_note: stdio is the default. 'http' is Streamable HTTP at /mcp with the SDK's DNS-rebinding protection (allowed_hosts/allowed_origins). 'sse' is deprecated but retained. Network modes bind 127.0.0.1 and refuse any non-loopback bind without a bearer token (--token or MEMEX_MCP_TOKEN).

auth.detail: stdio inherits the calling user's filesystem authority (per MCP spec, stdio servers take credentials from the environment). The network transport requires Authorization: Bearer <token>.

files.scope_note: All page reads and writes resolve under the wiki root passed via --wiki.

injected.detail: Page bodies are returned to the model as tool results. Content is authored by the user, but may include ingested third-party material, so it is treated as untrusted context.

sql.detail: Local SQLite FTS5 index. Reads are parameterised SELECTs; writes are index maintenance only (INSERT OR REPLACE / DELETE on the pages table, driven by a file path), never user-authored SQL.

adversarial: frontmatter injection through title and agent fields
path traversal through every page_type/slug argument
network transport without token refuses to start
contract: results use content blocks plus isError
